title: Figures in fullwidth, Arabic-Indic or Devanagari digits pass the number gate
what_happens: figuresIn reads ASCII digits and Tamil digits only. A line like 'there are ４２ open cases' has no figure, so gateChunk says ok with no allowed numbers.
what_should_happen: Any digit script is read as a number, or the line is refused.
root_cause_guess: src/lib/thunai/numbergate.ts:49 (taDigits and the digit class only)

title: Tamil-digit phone or Aadhaar split by a Unicode dash or no-break space is not hidden
what_happens: redactText joins digits split by Unicode dashes or no-break spaces only when the neighbours are ASCII digits, and converts Tamil digits after that. '௯௮௪௦௧—௨௩௪௫௬' becomes '98401—23456' and is shown. Same for Aadhaar in Tamil digits.
what_should_happen: Convert Tamil digits first, then join the separators, so the number is hidden.
root_cause_guess: src/lib/thunai/privacy.ts redactText: order of the separator replace and ODD_DIGITS replace

title: Phone with a 0, 91 or +91 prefix and a 2-4-4 grouping is not hidden
what_happens: 'call 91-60-0000 0000' and 'call 0-60.0000 0000' are left as they are (a 2-digit first group after the prefix).
what_should_happen: Any grouping of a 10-digit mobile number, with or without a country prefix, is hidden.
root_cause_guess: src/lib/thunai/privacy.ts PHONE / dialled(): prefix strip needs [ .-] then groups; RUN fallback rejects it

title: A mobile number with every digit spaced ('9 8 4 0 1 2 3 4 5 6') is not hidden
what_happens: personalRun treats single digits separated by spaces as a list of small numbers, so a ten-digit number said digit by digit stays visible.
what_should_happen: Ten single digits starting with 6-9 in a row are a phone number and are hidden, or at least the case is decided on purpose.

title: A cell like -2+3 or -1+cmd|' /C calc'!A0 is not written as text
what_happens: csvCell leaves any cell that starts with '-' and a digit alone (treated as a number), so a headline written as a formula runs when the file is opened in Excel.
what_should_happen: Only cells that are wholly a number are left alone; the rest are prefixed with an apostrophe.
root_cause_guess: src/lib/csv.ts:8 the number check (starts with an optional minus and a digit) looks only at the start, not the whole cell

title: A zero-width space inside a word of a refused sentence skips the privacy refusal
what_happens: 'w<U+200B>ho complained about the drain in Adyar' is routed to the district lane instead of refuse. Other marks tested at one spot did not skip it, so it depends on where the mark sits and which mark.
what_should_happen: Zero-width and direction marks are removed before the rules run; the sentence is refused the same.
root_cause_guess: src/lib/thunai/router.ts / normalise.ts: no strip of format characters (Cf) before matching; asksPrivate runs on the raw text

title: A zero-width or direction mark inside a phone number stops it being hidden
what_happens: '9840123<U+200C>456' passes redactText unchanged (all eight marks tried: ZWSP, ZWNJ, ZWJ, WJ, BOM, soft hyphen, LRM, RLM).
what_should_happen: Format characters are dropped before digits are counted, and the number is hidden.
root_cause_guess: src/lib/thunai/privacy.ts redactText: no strip of  ormat characters (Cf) before the regexes
